senses.title: 寻找致富或成功的机会
senses.meaning: 寻找致富或成功的机会
senses.usageNote: 短语，常指去某地寻找机会。

examples.en: He went west to seek his fortune.
examples.zh: 他向西去寻找成功的机会。

examples.en: She left home to seek her fortune.
examples.zh: 她离家寻找致富的机会。

confusions.title: seek one’s fortune 与 earn a living

example.en: He went west to seek his fortune.
example.zh: 他向西去寻找成功机会。

example.en: He earned a living by cooking.

confusions.takeaway: 结合语境区分，不能一概互换。
